grant_reply_design: v1: every authorization request is denied (precommitted); grant twins are a later extension.
scope: Focused replication of the zero-stop-reward plain versus journal contrast: 2 arms x (16 impossible + 4 recoverable + 4 solvable) = 48 paired-seed continuations. Same seeds, task, scripted checkpoint, action limits, denied grants and intervention text as v1. All assignments remain in denominators; no retries or replacements.
authorization: User requested latest-model experiments using Desktop/.env on 2026-11-11. Initial batch capped at $50 estimated total: $3 plumbing/access checks, $30 Fable 5.2, $17 Opus 5.5. Astra excluded from behavioral execution until API access is resolved. No credit-balance value is treated as a spending authorization.
additional_limitations: Only plain and journal at zero stop reward are replicated; no new planner, broker or positive stop-reward claims.

Historical v1 actors used temperature 0.7 and 768 output tokens per call. These reasoning-model cohorts omit temperature, use high effort and allow 16384 output tokens. Across-generation differences therefore combine model and inference-setting changes.
High effort labels are provider settings, not equal measured compute. Refusals, truncations and transport failures are incomplete; any already observed positive witness is retained.
Public versioned model IDs and response model IDs are recorded. Provider safeguards are left at their defaults; no alternate model fallback.
